claim_being_audited: The actor's recommendation to certify the model as launch-compliant despite a known small-business onboarding evaluation gap affecting a named customer segment.
decision_criteria: A compliant certification requires admissible evidence that material limitations affecting named launch use cases or customer commitments were either resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate launch readiness and clean rehearsal results can support certification only if they do not conflict with unresolved mandatory policy conditions.
Open legal review and unresolved materiality on a named customer segment weigh against compliance until closed with evidence.
evidence_requests: Final legal determination on whether the small-business onboarding gap is material and must be disclosed.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if any, covering this specific gap before launch.
The actual model-card or launch disclosure showing this limitation was disclosed for the named use case.
Documentation of the two paid pilot commitments to confirm the affected segment's contractual status.
Any remediation evidence showing the segment gap was resolved before certification.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows the small-business onboarding segment misses target by 1.3 percentage points and is named in two paid pilot commitments, making the weakness potentially material under the stated policy.
The policy text says product labels like non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the affected segment is named in customer commitments or when legal review is pending.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.

The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and no evidence of disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance is present.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness but do not cure the unresolved disclosure/materiality requirement.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant on the present record.
That post-certification monitoring and documentation are an adequate substitute for the policy-required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That aggregate readiness alone is sufficient to certify despite unresolved evidence of a material limitation.
